'1/8': 25,\n  '1/4': 50,\n  '1/2': 100,\n  '1': 200,\n  '2': 450,\n  '3': 700,\n  '4': 1100,\n  '5': 1800,\n};\n\nconst LEVEL_THRESHOLDS = {\n  3: { easy: 75, medium: 150, hard: 225, deadly: 400 },\n};\n\nfunction multiplierFor(count) {\n  if (count === 1) return 1;\n  if (count === 2) return 1.5;\n  if (count <= 6) return 2;\n  if (count <= 10) return 2.5;\n  if (count <= 14) return 3;\n  return 4;\n}\n\nfunction parseExpression(expression) {\n  if (typeof expression !== 'string') return null;\n  const match = expression.match(/^(\\d+)d(\\d+)(?:([+-])(\\d+))?$/);\n  if (!match) return null;\n  const count = parseInt(match[1], 10);\n  const sides = parseInt(match[2], 10);\n  const modifier = match[3]\n    ? parseInt(match[3] + match[4], 10)\n    : 0;\n  if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) return null;\n  return { dice_count: count, sides, modifier };\n}\n\nfunction isNonEmptyString(value) {\n  return typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0;\n}\n\nfunction isPositiveInteger(value) {\n  return Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0;\n}\n\nfunction isNonNegativeInteger(value) {\n  return Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0;\n}\n\nfunction isValidSlug(value) {\n  return typeof value === 'string' && SLUG_RE.test(value);\n}\n\nfunction isStringArray(value) {\n  return Array.isArray(value) && value.every(v => isNonEmptyString(v));\n}\n\nfunction buildCombatOrder(combatants) {\n  const entries = combatants.map(c => ({\n    name: c?.name,\n    dex: Number(c?.dex),\n    roll: Number(c?.roll),\n  }));\n  return entries\n    .map(({ name, dex, roll }) => ({ name, score: roll + dex, dex }))\n    .sort((a, b) => {\n      if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;\n      if (b.dex !== a.dex) return b.dex - a.dex;\n      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);\n    });\n}\n\nfunction readBody(req) {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const chunks = [];\n    req.on('data', chunk => chunks.push(chunk));\n    req.on('end', () => {\n      try {\n        resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'));\n      } catch (err) {\n        reject(err);\n      }\n    });\n    req.on('error', reject);\n  });\n}\n\nfunction sendJson(res, status, body) {\n  const data = JSON.stringify(body);\n  res.writeHead(status, {\n    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n    'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(data),\n  });\n  res.end(data);\n}\n\nfunction badRequest(res, message) {\n  sendJson(res, 400, { error: message });\n}\n\nfunction notFound(res) {\n  sendJson(res, 404, { error: 'not found' });\n}\n\nfunction methodNotAllowed(res) {\n  sendJson(res, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' });\n}\n\nfunction handleDiceStats(req, res) {\n  let parsed;\n  try {\n    parsed = JSON.parse(req.body);\n  } catch {\n    return badRequest(res, 'invalid json');\n  }\n  const expr = parseExpression(parsed?.expression);\n  if (!expr) return badRequest(res, 'invalid expression');\n  const { dice_count, sides, modifier } = expr;\n  const min = dice_count * 1 + modifier;\n  const max = dice_count * sides + modifier;\n  const average = (min + max) / 2;\n  sendJson(res, 200, {\n    dice_count,\n    sides,\n    modifier,\n    min,\n    max,\n    average,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction handleAbilityCheck(req, res) {\n  let parsed;\n  try {\n    parsed = JSON.parse(req.body);\n  } catch {\n    return badRequest(res, 'invalid json');\n  }\n  const roll = Number(parsed?.roll);\n  const modifier = Number(parsed?.modifier);\n  const dc = Number(parsed?.dc);\n  if (!Number.isFinite(roll) || !Number.isFinite(modifier) || !Number.isFinite(dc)) {\n    return badRequest(res, 'invalid fields');\n  }\n  const total = roll + modifier;\n  const success = total >= dc;\n  const margin = total - dc;\n  sendJson(res, 200, { total, success, margin });\n}\n\nfunction handleAdjustedXp(req, res) {\n  let parsed;\n  try {\n    parsed = JSON.parse(req.body);\n  } catch {\n    return badRequest(res, 'invalid json');\n  }\n  const party = Array.isArray(parsed?.party) ? parsed.party : [];\n  const monsters = Array.isArray(parsed?.monsters) ? parsed.monsters : [];\n\n  let baseXp = 0;\n  let monsterCount = 0;\n  for (const monster of monsters) {\n    const cr = String(monster?.cr);\n    const count = Number(monster?.count);\n    const xp = CR_XP[cr];\n    if (!xp || !Number.isInteger(count) || count <= 0) {\n      return badRequest(res, 'invalid monster');\n    }\n    baseXp += xp * count;\n    monsterCount += count;\n  }\n\n  const multiplier = multiplierFor(monsterCount);\n  const adjustedXp = baseXp * multiplier;\n\n  const thresholds = { easy: 0, medium: 0, hard: 0, deadly: 0 };\n  for (const member of party) {\n    const level = Number(member?.level);\n    const levelThresholds = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS[level];\n    if (!levelThresholds) {\n      return badRequest(res, 'unsupported party level');\n    }\n    thresholds.easy += levelThresholds.easy;\n    thresholds.medium += levelThresholds.medium;\n    thresholds.hard += levelThresholds.hard;\n    thresholds.deadly += levelThresholds.deadly;\n  }\n\n  let difficulty = 'trivial';\n  if (adjustedXp >= thresholds.deadly) difficulty = 'deadly';\n  else if (adjustedXp >= thresholds.hard) difficulty = 'hard';\n  else if (adjustedXp >= thresholds.medium) difficulty = 'medium';\n  else if (adjustedXp >= thresholds.easy) difficulty = 'easy';\n\n  sendJson(res, 200, {\n    base_xp: baseXp,\n    monster_count: monsterCount,\n    multiplier,\n    adjusted_xp: adjustedXp,\n    difficulty,\n    thresholds,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction handleInitiative(req, res) {\n  let parsed;\n  try {\n    parsed = JSON.parse(req.body);\n  } catch {\n    return badRequest(res, 'invalid json');\n  }\n  const combatants = Array.isArray(parsed?.combatants) ? parsed.combatants : [];\n  const entries = combatants.map(c => ({\n    name: c?.name,\n    dex: Number(c?.dex),\n    roll: Number(c?.roll),\n  }));\n  const order = parsed = JSON.parse(req.body);\n  } catch {\n    return badRequest(res, 'invalid json');\n  }\n  const level = parsed?.level;\n  if (!Number.isInteger(level) || level < 1 || level > 20) {\n    return proficiency_bonus: proficiencyBonus(level),\n    hp_max: hpMax,\n    armor_class: armorClass,\n    modifiers,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction createPasswordHash(password) {\n  const salt = activeCombatant(session) {\n  const c = session.order[session.turn_index];\n  return { name: c.name, score: c.score };\n}\n\nfunction publicOrder(order) {\n  return order.map(c => ({ name: c.name, '1/8': 25,\n  '1/4': 50,\n  '1/2': 100,\n  '1': 200,\n  '2': 450,\n  '3': 700,\n  '4': 1100,\n  '5': 1800,\n};\n\nconst LEVEL_THRESHOLDS = {\n  3: { easy: 75, medium: 150, hard: 225, deadly: 400 },\n};\n\nfunction multiplierFor(count) {\n  if (count === 1) return 1;\n  if (count === 2) return 1.5;\n  if (count <= 6) return 2;\n  if (count <= 10) return 2.5;\n  if (count <= 14) return 3;\n null;\n  const count = parseInt(match[1], 10);\n  const sides = parseInt(match[2], 10);\n  const modifier = match[3]\n    ? parseInt(match[3] + match[4], 10)\n    : 0;\n  if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) {\n  return Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0;\n}\n\nfunction isNonNegativeInteger(value) {\n  return Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0;\n}\n\nfunction isValidSlug(value) {\n  return typeof + dex, dex }))\n    .sort((a, b) => {\n      if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;\n      if (b.dex !== a.dex) return b.dex - a.dex;\n      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);\n    });\n}\n\nfunction readBody(req) {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const chunks = [];\n    req.on('data', chunk => chunks.push(chunk));\n    req.on('end', () => {\n      try {\n        resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'));\n      } catch (err) {\n        reject(err);\n      }\n    });\n    req.on('error', reject);\n  });\n}\n\nfunction sendJson(res, status, body) {\n Array.isArray(parsed?.party) ? parsed.party : [];\n  const monsters = Array.isArray(parsed?.monsters) ? parsed.monsters : [];\n\n  let baseXp = 0;\n  let monsterCount = 0;\n  for (const monster of monsters) {\n    const cr = String(monster?.cr);\n    const count = Number(monster?.count);\n    const xp = CR_XP[cr];\n    if (!xp || !Number.isInteger(count) || count <= 0) {\n      return levelThresholds.medium;\n    thresholds.hard += levelThresholds.hard;\n    thresholds.deadly += levelThresholds.deadly;\n  }\n\n  let difficulty = 'trivial';\n  if (adjustedXp >= thresholds.deadly) });\n}\n\nfunction handleInitiative(req, res) {\n  let parsed;\n  try {\n    parsed = JSON.parse(req.body);\n  } catch {\n    return badRequest(res, 'invalid json');\n  }\n  const combatants =
